bore_in.note: 90.0 mm. Arithmetic: 90 x 90 x 101.6 x 0.7854 x 6 = 3,878.1 cc, matching the 3,878 cc published by Toyota (lineage page), Elgin and Wikipedia. Toyota's 1950 table states 3,870 cc.
